description: Analyze changesets over an optional date, branch, owner, or comment filter. Read-only.

branch.description: Optional branch path, for example /main or /main/release.

commentLike.description: Optional substring to match in changeset comments.

maxResults.description: Maximum changesets to return, from 1 to 500. Default: 100.

since.description: Optional start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

until.description: Optional end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: uvcs_changeset_analytics
